items.body: The record says `TestHelperRuntimeCostProfile` passed "on the candidate release helper", but never names that helper. The committed `runtime-cost-go-metrics.json` shows `helper_sha256` `7c713db8…`. That hash is not in `helpers.sha256` or the md file. It also differs from the release helper the task Evidence cites (`19493564…cab3`). The rerun steps rebuild only `diag-CAND`, so it is unclear whether this release helper includes the `asm` change. The Go-owner/helper-owner identity result still holds either way, since the hashed bytes did not change. Separately, `helpers.sha256` still lists `14c39347…` (`target-diag-CAND`, the pre-fix candidate from 2026-10-14) with no label, next to the current `diag-CAND` hash.
items.suggestion: Record the release helper sha256 and its source commit in the "Host and identities" section. Mark the `14c39347…` line in `helpers.sha256` as the superseded 2026-10-14 candidate, or remove it.
